title: Choosing threading vs multiprocessing vs asyncio
question: When would you choose threading, multiprocessing, or asyncio for a Python backend service? Walk through the decision tree for CPU-bound, I/O-bound, and mixed workloads.

title: Thread pool making backend slower
question: A colleague adds a ThreadPoolExecutor to parallelize database queries but the service gets slower. Diagnose all possible root causes (GIL, connection pool contention, context switching overhead).

title: Blocking call in asyncio event loop
question: A blocking database call inside an async view freezes your entire FastAPI service. How do you diagnose and fix it, and what is loop.run_in_executor() for?

title: Deadlock detection and prevention
question: Two threads each hold a lock the other needs. Describe the classic deadlock scenario and at least two Python-specific prevention strategies.

title: Rate limiting with asyncio.Semaphore
question: You need to call a third-party API that allows max 10 concurrent requests. Show how to implement this rate limiting with asyncio.Semaphore in a FastAPI route.

title: Process pool for image processing
question: A Flask endpoint triggers CPU-intensive image thumbnailing. The main process blocks during processing. Design a solution using multiprocessing without blocking the web server.

title: Cancelling tasks on shutdown
question: An asyncio service must cancel all running tasks gracefully on SIGTERM. Write the shutdown handler that cancels tasks, awaits them, and closes the event loop.
